system.description: You bury a piece of rotted meat and feed it the corruption of a nearby creature.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the creature also regains d6 HP.
outcomes.success: The creature is cured of the Infected condition or of one curse.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the corruption stays.
outcomes.ruin: The corruption crawls into you instead: you are Infected. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
